material_findings.title: Veria Labs ctf-agent is a relevant multi-agent CTF architecture evaluation lead
material_findings.summary: verialabs/ctf-agent is a public MIT-licensed CTF solver architecture that coordinates multiple AI models and races isolated Docker solver swarms across CTF challenges. Its README claims 52/52 challenges solved and first place at BSidesSF 2026, but this run treats that result as project-authored evidence rather than independently reproduced repository truth.
material_findings.recommended_action: Build/Integration should compare its coordinator, swarm isolation, message-sharing, challenge polling, and tool-image design against the suite's existing agent/case contracts using deterministic local or authorized CTF fixtures. Do not import code or adopt benchmark/capability claims until dependency, credential-handling, license/provenance, direct-script/runtime, and reproducibility review is complete.
